discovery_profile.class_title: Candidate "Little Red Dot" (JWST High-z Dusty AGN / Compact Core)
discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Compact blue rest-frame UV continuum with sudden, extreme red slope in [F277W - F444W] = +2.15, typical of JWST Little Red Dots.

hypotheses.primary: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: High): Shrouded broad-line AGN with dense dusty torus emitting hot dust continuum (Matthee et al. 2024, Greene et al. 2023).
hypotheses.alternative: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: Medium): Hyper-compact stellar core (r_e < 150 pc) with extreme dust attenuation (Labbé et al. 2023).
hypotheses.required_observations: Missing: NIRSpec PRISM / G395H spectroscopy to confirm broad Hα emission (FWHM > 2000 km/s) and separate AGN torus from stellar emission.

spectral_excess.mechanism: Broad-line Hα + AGN torus hot dust continuum

jwst_followup.science_goal: Search for broad Hα line emission (FWHM > 2000 km/s) to definitively confirm black hole virial mass.
jwst_followup.target_acquisition: NIRSpec WATA required: Verify bright reference star (V < 20 mag) within 2 arcmin.

discovery_profile.class_title: Extreme Emission Line Galaxy (EELG / [O III] Starburst)
discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Single-band flux surge in F200W (+320% relative to stellar continuum) caused by extreme rest-frame [O III] λλ4959,5007 and Hβ line emission.

hypotheses.primary: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: High): Pristine, low-metallicity (Z < 0.1 Z☉) mini-starburst with high ionization parameter producing extreme equivalent widths (EW₀ > 1200 Å) (Tang et al. 2019).
hypotheses.alternative: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: Low): Dense Wolf-Rayet star population producing intense ionizing Lyman continuum radiation (Schaerer et al. 2022).
hypotheses.required_observations: Missing: NIRSpec PRISM / CLEAR rest-frame optical spectroscopy to confirm [O III] / Hβ line ratio and measure electron temperature Te.

spectral_excess.mechanism: Rest-frame [O III] λλ4959,5007 + Hβ nebular emission

jwst_followup.science_goal: Resolve [O III] / Hβ flux ratio to accurately measure gas-phase metallicity and ionizing photon escape fraction.
jwst_followup.target_acquisition: NIRSpec WATA required: Verify bright reference star (V < 20 mag) within 2 arcmin.

discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Massive galaxy (8.3×10¹⁰ M☉) already completely quenched (SFR = 0.02 M☉/yr) when the Universe was only 1.5 Gyr old.

hypotheses.primary: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: High): Extreme quasar blowout feedback expelling cold gas from the halo (Carnall et al. 2023).
hypotheses.alternative: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: Low): Rapid gas exhaustion following extreme high-z compaction (Zolotov et al. 2015).
hypotheses.required_observations: Missing: NIRSpec PRISM / CLEAR spectroscopy to detect rest-frame optical absorption lines and constrain formation epoch.

jwst_followup.science_goal: Measure age of stellar continuum to constrain how fast a 100-billion star galaxy can form and starve in the early cosmos.
jwst_followup.target_acquisition: NIRSpec WATA required: Verify bright reference star (V < 20 mag) within 2 arcmin.

discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Completely undetectable in optical short bands (F090W > 33 mag), but blazing intensely in long-wavelength NIRCam (F444W = 22.11 mag).

hypotheses.primary: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: High): Optically-dark, dust-enshrouded massive starburst (Av = 3.6 mag) representing hidden cosmic star formation (Barrufet et al. 2023, Williams et al. 2019).
hypotheses.alternative: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: Medium): High-redshift dusty submillimeter galaxy (SMG) transitioning into a massive elliptical (Casey et al. 2014).
hypotheses.required_observations: Missing: MIRI Low-Resolution Spectroscopy (LRS) to detect rest-frame mid-infrared 7.7 μm and 11.3 μm PAH dust emission.

jwst_followup.science_goal: Probe rest-frame mid-infrared PAH dust features at 7.7 μm and 11.3 μm to measure the hidden star formation rate.
jwst_followup.target_acquisition: MIRI target acquisition: Target bright enough in F444W (22.1 mag) for direct centroiding.

galaxies.qc_failure_title: Tier 1: Negative Flux Density in F090W
galaxies.qc_failure_detail: Evaluated F090W flux = -1.42e-33 erg/s/cm²/Hz. Violates non-negative photon emission invariant. Root cause: Background over-subtraction or unmasked interpolation error.
Measured Dn4000 break = 0.42. Astrophysical lower bound is 0.70 (pure O/B starburst). Indicates corrupted continuum or unphysical stellar population synthesis grid interpolation.

galaxies.qc_failure_title: Tier 2: Stellar Age Exceeds Cosmic Time at z=7.2
galaxies.qc_failure_detail: Derived mean stellar age = 8.4 Gyr. At z = 7.2, the age of the Universe is only 0.74 Gyr. Impossible physical paradox (stars older than the universe).
Evaluated [F150W - F444W] = +4.85 with [F200W - F277W] = -1.92. Lies > 5 standard deviations outside cosmological locus. Flagged for automatic quarantine.
